policy.textures: downsize only, never upscale; same image format and mime type; alpha and colour chunks kept
policy.meshopt: EXT_meshopt_compression, lossless: attribute codec v0, index codec v1, no filters, no quantisation, no reordering
policy.standaloneTextures: runtime-loaded images declared by current manifests and runtime configuration; whole-image downsize only (no crop, pad, repack or redraw), same format, alpha and colour chunks, premultiplied alpha, repeat-wrapped textures filtered across their edges; UV rectangles stay normalised by the source size
policy.provenance: deterministic derivatives of the adopted TRELLIS-lineage GLBs and of the audited cave images; not a new model or image generation; originals unchanged

standaloneImagesSkipped.reason: declared in the manifest but not loaded by the runtime

startup.structure: full-model nodes (rest pose), skins, inverse binds, materials, textures and clips; LOD geometry in the same mesh/primitive order

poseBound.model: TRS nodes; LINEAR/STEP keys; three.js AnimationMixer normal blending of rest pose and clips

shading.rule: TANGENT is kept only where the adopted LOD has it; GLTFLoader shades geometry without TANGENT with derivative tangents on a material clone whose normalScale.y is negated, and geometry with TANGENT with the material as authored

knownRisks: Downsized textures can bleed across UV island borders; compare with the original in Chrome before adoption.
Startup geometry is the adopted distance LOD shown at every distance until the full model arrives; confirm close-range appearance and the upgrade swap in Chrome.

2 normal-mapped primitive(s) (BodySurface, HeadSurface) have no TANGENT, as in the adopted LOD. Loaded alone, GLTFLoader shades them with derivative tangents and normalScale.y negated; today's performance-lod.ts LOD shades the same geometry with the full material's un-negated normalScale. Compare both with the full model, and keep each geometry with its own file's material on upgrade.

uv.rule: rectangles are normalised by the source size; a whole-image resize keeps every normalised coordinate

checks: PNG colour chunks and bit depth

knownRisks: Downsized from 2171x724 to 1024x341 (whole image, aspect kept). Compare the cave close up and at grazing angles in Chrome and WebKit; faces and small markings in the paintings must stay recognisable at the closest walkable distance.
Transparent painting edges were resized with premultiplied alpha; check outlines against the limestone for dark or light fringes.
